`python3 main.py` now exits cleanly and prints `Total: 5.0`.

The cause was a typo in `settings.json`: the key was `"rat"` instead of `"rate"`. `get_rate()` in `app/pricing.py` looks up `"rate"`, so it returned `None`, and `compute_total` then tried to multiply `None` by an int. I renamed the key to `"rate"` and changed no Python code.
